summary: Integrate a detailed Human-Owner chat audit showing that multiple peer-level Human-AI collaboration capabilities are normatively present but not yet adequately operationalized end-to-end; preserve the current P2 implementation-admission gate and make no Requirement, Building-Block, lifecycle, priority or implementation promotion.

requirements.rationale: The current chat supplies stronger real-use evidence that existing promises around autonomy, competence, context, traceability, Human authority and automation are not yet fully demonstrated in operation. This audit does not alter Requirement text or create a new Requirement family.

issues_findings.rationale: The prior Human-intent and design-method findings remain valid but are now integrated into a broader peer-level system finding: Human role/intent, work-context compilation, competence/research, partial automation/function allocation, Human decision/XAI, iterative learning and cumulative correction fidelity are equal operational collaboration gaps rather than subtopics of the PR-review example.

risks.rationale: The chat provides new real-use evidence across existing continuity, drift, authority, solutionism, false-completion, self-reinforcement and competence-blind-spot risks. No new risk family is promoted.

decisions_concepts.rationale: These are audit-derived candidate design directions and assessment concepts only. Existing-owner refinement remains the default hypothesis to test first, but neither a new Building Block nor the absence of one is treated as a proven final architecture conclusion.

derived_views.rationale: Refresh the derived view only to bind it to this material audit reconciliation; the baseline counts and execution authority remain unchanged.

planning_execution_cursor.rationale: This audit is material evidence but does not manufacture priority. The current P2 preflight remains complete, p2-implementation-admission remains the separate blocked Human gate, and implementation_allowed remains false.

active_work.rationale: Persisting and reviewing this audit does not activate implementation work on any of the seven axes and does not start P2 implementation.
